Yes — for a two-month stay, you'll need an e-Visa.

Germans get visa-free entry to Vietnam, but only for up to 45 days. Since you're staying about 60 days, that exceeds the visa-free limit, so you'll need to apply for an e-Visa instead.

Details on the e-Visa:
- Covers stays of up to 90 days, so it comfortably covers your two-month trip
- Costs USD 25 (single entry) or USD 50 (multiple entry)
- Apply online at https://evisa.gov.vn/, processing typically takes 2-3 business days (faster options available for a higher fee)
- Available to all nationalities, valid for air, land, and sea entry at approved ports

Other notes:
- Your passport must be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date
- The 45-day visa-free exemption for Germans is currently set to run until 2028-03-05

This is based on policy data as of 2026-08-17 — please double-check current requirements at evisa.gov.vn before you travel, since immigration rules can change.
